name: YouTube Premium

fastest.text: Go to youtube.com/paid_memberships, choose your membership and cancel. Joined in the iPhone app? Cancel in your Apple account.

steps: Go to youtube.com/paid_memberships in a web browser and sign in.
Next to YouTube Premium, select Manage membership.
Choose the option to cancel and confirm.
Check the Status on that page to make sure the membership is ending.
note: Pay through Google Play? Cancel in your Google Play account settings.

faq.q: Do I keep Premium after cancelling?
faq.a: Yes. Your benefits continue until the end of the billing period, and you won't be charged again unless you re-subscribe.
Yes. YouTube lets you pause a paid membership instead of cancelling it.
Premium Lite, with fewer features, is $8.99/mo in the US.
